description: Wayback Machine snapshots of a public URL: the capture closest to a date, the list of captures in a date range (one per day, max 500), first and last capture, and mode=diff, which compares the latest snapshot's text with the live page (added and removed lines, max 200 each). Diff is line-based and does not parse JavaScript-rendered pages. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

date.description: Closest snapshot to this date, YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

to.description: Captures up to this date, YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

url.description: Public http(s) URL to look up

name: web_archive
title: Web Archive
